title: populus arizonica
intro: Populus arizonica, commonly known as Arizona poplar or Black cottonwood, is a deciduous tree native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. The health benefits of Populus arizonica include its potential to help lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its flavonoid content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Populus arizonica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
